title: Converting metric units
examples: How do I change kilograms to grams?
Can you show me how to convert meters to centimeters?
What is the difference between a liter and milliliters?

explain.say: Today we will learn to change between metric units. We can change units for length and mass. This is called converting units.
When we go from a bigger unit to a smaller unit, we multiply. For example, one meter is equal to one hundred centimeters. So we multiply by one hundred.
Let us try converting three meters to centimeters. We multiply three by one hundred. Three times one hundred equals three hundred centimeters.
When we go from a smaller unit to a bigger unit, we divide. For example, one hundred grams is equal to one kilogram. So we divide by one hundred.
Let us try converting five hundred grams to kilograms. We divide five hundred by one hundred. Five hundred divided by one hundred equals five kilograms.

faq.q: What is the difference between meters and centimeters?
faq.a: A meter is a larger unit of length than a centimeter. There are one hundred centimeters in one meter.
asks: How many centimeters are in a meter?
What is the relationship between m and cm?

faq.q: Do I always multiply when converting units?
faq.a: No, you multiply when going from a big unit to a small unit. You divide when going from a small unit to a big unit.
asks: When do I use multiplication for units?
Should I always multiply when changing units?

faq.q: How do I convert kilograms to grams?
faq.a: You know that one kilogram is one thousand grams. So you multiply the number of kilograms by one thousand.
asks: What is the rule for kg to g?
Can you show me kg to g conversion?

faq.q: Can I use decimals when converting units?
faq.a: Yes, you can. Dividing by one hundred is the same as moving the decimal point two places to the left.
asks: Is moving the decimal point okay?
What about using decimals in conversions?

faq.q: What if I am converting liters to milliliters?
faq.a: Since a liter is bigger, you multiply by one thousand. One liter equals one thousand milliliters.
asks: How many ml in a liter?

facts: There are one hundred centimeters in one meter.
There are one thousand grams in one kilogram.
When going from a larger unit to a smaller unit, you multiply.
When going from a smaller unit to a larger unit, you divide.

quiz.say: What is five thousand grams in kilograms?
quiz.why: You divide five thousand by one thousand because grams are smaller than kilograms.

wrong.1: This is wrong because you only divided by ten instead of one thousand.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you moved the decimal point too many places to the left.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you forgot to divide by the correct amount.

quiz.say: If you have two and a half meters, how many centimeters is that?
quiz.why: You multiply two point five by one hundred. This gives you two hundred fifty centimeters.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you did not change the units at all.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you multiplied by one thousand instead of one hundred.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you treated the decimal point like it was just a single digit.
